title: Prop firm plan rules
description: One prop-firm plan (one account size of one program): its rules and its prices, each with the firm page it was checked against and the date it was checked. Rules and prices are dated separately: rules_verified and prices_verified. Values are the rules as AlgoLift's published prop rules registry records them, in the shape AlgoLift's simulator reads; simulation_notes says where the simulation approximates a rule.

id.description: <firm slug>/<plan slug>, the file's path under rules/ without .json.

status.description: active: the firm sells this plan. discontinued: it no longer does (kept because AlgoLift still simulates it). unverified: not checked yet.

rules_verified.description: The oldest verified date among the rules; null while any rule is unverified or differs from its source.

prices_verified.description: The oldest verified date among the prices; null while any price is unverified or differs from its source. Prices change more often than rules, so they carry their own date.

anyOf.description: The evaluation (the challenge) a trader passes to be funded. null on an instant-funding plan.

payouts.description: When and how much a funded trader can withdraw.

prices.description: What the plan costs, in US dollars.

simulation_notes.description: Where AlgoLift's simulation of this plan approximates or leaves out a rule, in plain words.

generated.description: How this file was made: from AlgoLift's published prop rules registry snapshot, by AlgoLift's exporter, through the simulator's catalogue built from that snapshot (engine/catalog.json). The validator checks both hashes.

engine_sha256.description: sha256 of the plan's entry in engine/catalog.json, as canonical JSON.

values_sha256.description: sha256 of this file's rule and price values, as canonical JSON.

source_url.description: The firm's own page this rule was checked against. null means the rule has not been verified yet; the validator refuses a file with any null source.

verified.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) the rule was last checked against source_url. null means never; the validator refuses a null date, and a date older than the re-check window.

status.description: verified: checked against source_url on the verified date, and the firm states this value. not_stated: the firm's pages checked on that date do not state this rule, so the value is AlgoLift's assumption (see simulation_notes). differs: the firm's page states something else; the value stays as AlgoLift simulates it until the simulator is updated, and the validator refuses the file. unverified: not checked yet; the validator refuses the file.

account.size.title: Account size
account.size.description: Account size. The account's nominal size: the balance the evaluation starts at. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

account.instant_funding.title: Instant funding
account.instant_funding.description: Instant funding. True when the plan has no evaluation: the fee buys a funded account directly. Unit: flag (True or false.)

account.trading_day_start.title: Trading day starts
account.trading_day_start.description: Trading day starts. When the firm's trading day begins. A trade after this time counts toward the next trading day for every daily rule: daily loss, consistency, winning days and minimum days. Unit: clock_new_york (A time of day, HH:MM, New York time.)

account.trading_hours.title: Trading hours
account.trading_hours.description: Trading hours. The hours in which the account may hold positions and trade, New York time; null when it may trade whenever the exchange is open. Unit: time_window (An object { start, end }, each HH:MM New York time; an end before the start runs past midnight.)

evaluation.profit_target.title: Profit target
evaluation.profit_target.description: Profit target. The profit needed to pass the evaluation. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

evaluation.max_drawdown.title: Maximum drawdown
evaluation.max_drawdown.description: Maximum drawdown. The drawdown: the floor sits this far below the balance it follows (see drawdown_type), and reaching it fails the evaluation. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

evaluation.drawdown_type.title: Drawdown type
evaluation.drawdown_type.description: Drawdown type. How the drawdown floor follows the balance: end_of_day trails the highest end-of-day balance; intraday trails the highest balance reached at any moment, open profit included; static never moves. Unit: choice (One of the listed values.)

evaluation.drawdown_stops_at.title: Trailing drawdown stops at
evaluation.drawdown_stops_at.description: Trailing drawdown stops at. Where a trailing floor stops rising: at the starting balance, at the balance of the profit target, or never. Unit: choice (One of the listed values.)

evaluation.daily_loss_limit.title: Daily loss limit
evaluation.daily_loss_limit.description: Daily loss limit. The most the account may lose in one trading day; null when the plan has none. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

evaluation.consistency_max_day_pct.title: Consistency
evaluation.consistency_max_day_pct.description: Consistency. The largest share of the total profit one trading day may contribute when the evaluation passes; null when the plan has no consistency rule. Unit: percent (A percentage: 50 means 50%.)

evaluation.min_trading_days.title: Minimum trading days
evaluation.min_trading_days.description: Minimum trading days. Trading days needed before the evaluation can pass; null when there is no minimum. Unit: trading_days (Trading days (a day the account traded, on the firm's trading-day clock).)

evaluation.time_limit_days.title: Time limit
evaluation.time_limit_days.description: Time limit. Calendar days the evaluation may run before it expires; null when it has no time limit. Unit: calendar_days (Calendar days.)

evaluation.max_contracts.title: Maximum contracts
evaluation.max_contracts.description: Maximum contracts. The most contracts that may be open at once; null when contract_growth sets the limit instead. Unit: contracts (E-mini contracts; one E-mini equals 10 micro contracts.)

evaluation.contract_growth.title: Contract limit growth
evaluation.contract_growth.description: Contract limit growth. A contract limit that grows with profit: start contracts, plus one for every add_one_per_usd of profit at the start of the day; null when the limit is fixed. Unit: contract_growth (An object { start (E-minis), add_one_per_usd (US dollars of profit per extra contract) }.)

funded.starting_balance.title: Funded starting balance
funded.starting_balance.description: Funded starting balance. The balance the funded account starts at. 0 means the account counts profit from zero, with its drawdown floor below zero. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

funded.max_drawdown.title: Maximum drawdown
funded.max_drawdown.description: Maximum drawdown. The drawdown: the floor sits this far below the balance it follows (see drawdown_type), and reaching it closes the funded account. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

funded.drawdown_type.title: Drawdown type
funded.drawdown_type.description: Drawdown type. How the drawdown floor follows the balance: end_of_day trails the highest end-of-day balance; intraday trails the highest balance reached at any moment, open profit included; static never moves. Unit: choice (One of the listed values.)

funded.drawdown_stops_above_start.title: Trailing drawdown stops at
funded.drawdown_stops_above_start.description: Trailing drawdown stops at. A trailing floor stops rising once it reaches the funded starting balance plus this amount; 0 means it stops at the funded starting balance. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

funded.drawdown_after_payout.title: Drawdown after a payout
funded.drawdown_after_payout.description: Drawdown after a payout. After the first payout, or after every payout, the floor moves to the funded starting balance plus floor_above_start; null when payouts do not move the floor. Unit: payout_lock (An object { after (first_payout or every_payout), floor_above_start (US dollars) }.)

funded.daily_loss_limit.title: Daily loss limit
funded.daily_loss_limit.description: Daily loss limit. The most the account may lose in one trading day; null when the plan has none. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

funded.max_contracts.title: Maximum contracts
funded.max_contracts.description: Maximum contracts. The most contracts that may be open at once; null when contract_scaling or contract_growth sets the limit instead. Unit: contracts (E-mini contracts; one E-mini equals 10 micro contracts.)

funded.contract_scaling.title: Contract scaling
funded.contract_scaling.description: Contract scaling. The contract limit by profit above the funded starting balance, read at the start of each day: each step applies once that profit reaches its profit_above; null when there is no scaling plan. Unit: contract_scaling (A list of steps, each { profit_above (US dollars), max_contracts (E-minis) }.)

funded.contract_growth.title: Contract limit growth
funded.contract_growth.description: Contract limit growth. A contract limit that grows with profit: start contracts, plus one for every add_one_per_usd of profit at the start of the day; null when the limit is fixed. Unit: contract_growth (An object { start (E-minis), add_one_per_usd (US dollars of profit per extra contract) }.)

funded.reduced_size_until_buffer.title: Reduced size until the buffer
funded.reduced_size_until_buffer.description: Reduced size until the buffer. Until the balance first reaches the funded starting balance plus until_profit_above, only this fraction of max_contracts may be open (rounded down, at least one); null when the full limit applies from the start. Unit: reduced_size (An object { fraction (of max_contracts), until_profit_above (US dollars) }.)

payouts.min_trading_days.title: Trading days between payouts
payouts.min_trading_days.description: Trading days between payouts. Trading days needed since the last payout (since funding, for the first) before a payout can be requested; null when there is no minimum. Unit: trading_days (Trading days (a day the account traded, on the firm's trading-day clock).) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.min_calendar_days_between.title: Calendar days between payouts
payouts.min_calendar_days_between.description: Calendar days between payouts. Calendar days needed since the last payout (since funding, for the first) before a payout can be requested; null when there is no such rule. Unit: calendar_days (Calendar days.)

payouts.min_winning_days.title: Winning days
payouts.min_winning_days.description: Winning days. Winning days needed since the last payout before a payout can be requested; null when not required. Unit: trading_days (Trading days (a day the account traded, on the firm's trading-day clock).) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.winning_day_min_profit.title: A winning day makes at least
payouts.winning_day_min_profit.description: A winning day makes at least. The profit a trading day must make to count as a winning day; null when winning days are not required. Unit: usd (US dollars.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.consistency_max_day_pct.title: Payout consistency
payouts.consistency_max_day_pct.description: Payout consistency. The largest share of the counted profit (see profit_basis) one trading day since the last payout may contribute before a payout is allowed; null when there is no such rule. Unit: percent (A percentage: 50 means 50%.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.profit_basis.title: Profit counted from
payouts.profit_basis.description: Profit counted from. Where the profit counted toward a payout is measured from: the last payout (since_last_payout) or the start of the funded account (since_funded). Unit: choice (One of the listed values.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.min_profit.title: Profit before a payout
payouts.min_profit.description: Profit before a payout. The profit, counted from profit_basis, needed before a payout can be requested; null when there is no minimum. Unit: usd (US dollars.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.buffer.title: Buffer kept in the account
payouts.buffer.description: Buffer kept in the account. Profit above the funded starting balance that must stay in the account; a payout comes only from profit above it. 0 means no buffer. Unit: usd (US dollars.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.max_payout.title: Largest payout
payouts.max_payout.description: Largest payout. The largest single payout; null when there is no fixed cap. Unit: usd (US dollars.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.max_payout_pct_of_profit.title: Payout share of profit
payouts.max_payout_pct_of_profit.description: Payout share of profit. A payout may take at most this share of the profit above the buffer; null when the whole profit above the buffer may be paid out. Unit: percent (A percentage: 50 means 50%.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.max_payout_pct_of_balance.title: Payout share of the balance
payouts.max_payout_pct_of_balance.description: Payout share of the balance. A payout may be at most this share of the account balance; null when there is no such cap. Unit: percent (A percentage: 50 means 50%.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.max_payout_multiple_of_recent_pr.title: Payout multiple of recent profit
payouts.max_payout_multiple_of_recent_pr.description: Payout multiple of recent profit. A payout may be at most this multiple of the profit made since the last payout; null when there is no such cap. Unit: multiple (A multiplier: 2 means twice.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.profit_split_pct.title: Profit split
payouts.profit_split_pct.description: Profit split. The trader's share of each payout. Unit: percent (A percentage: 50 means 50%.) A rule that can change with the payout number is one value when it is the same for every payout, or a list: the first entry applies to the first payout, the second to the second, and the last entry to every later payout.

payouts.lifetime_max_payouts.title: Payouts before the account closes
payouts.lifetime_max_payouts.description: Payouts before the account closes. The funded account closes after this many payouts; null when there is no such limit. Unit: count (A count.)

payouts.lifetime_max_payout_usd.title: Total payouts before the account closes
payouts.lifetime_max_payout_usd.description: Total payouts before the account closes. The funded account closes once its payouts add up to this amount; null when there is no such limit. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

prices.evaluation_fee.title: Evaluation fee
prices.evaluation_fee.description: Evaluation fee. The price of the evaluation, or of the account itself on an instant-funding plan. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

prices.recurring_fee.title: Recurring fee
prices.recurring_fee.description: Recurring fee. Charged again every recurring_fee_every_days while the evaluation is open; null when the evaluation fee is paid once. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

prices.recurring_fee_every_days.title: Recurring fee period
prices.recurring_fee_every_days.description: Recurring fee period. How often the recurring fee is charged; null when there is no recurring fee. Unit: calendar_days (Calendar days.)

prices.reset_fee.title: Reset fee
prices.reset_fee.description: Reset fee. The price to restart a failed evaluation; null when the plan offers no reset and a new evaluation is bought instead. Unit: usd (US dollars.)

prices.activation_fee.title: Activation fee
prices.activation_fee.description: Activation fee. Charged once when the account becomes funded; 0 when there is none. Unit: usd (US dollars.)
